metadata.author: The Wiggles
metadata.description:
It’s The Wiggles biggest musical extravaganza ever! This brand-new Best Of collection brings together 20 of the most beloved and iconic songs from The Wiggles’ incredible catalogue. From timeless classics like Hot Potato, Fruit Salad, and Do the Propeller! to exciting newer hits, there’s something for every little Wiggles fan to enjoy.  You’ll also find cherished nursery rhymes including Hokey Pokey, and Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star.  

Join The Wiggles and their lovable friends—Dorothy the Dinosaur, Captain Feathersword, Wags the Dog, Henry the Octopus, and Shirley Shawn the Unicorn—for a joyful, energetic, and fun-filled musical journey that’s perfect for singing, dancing, and family time.  

The Wiggles are: Evie Ferris, Anthony Field, Lucia Field, Lachlan Gillespie, Tsehay Hawkins, Catarina Mete, John Pearce, and Simon Pryce.
